data.one_liner: Web implementation of Firebase Cloud Functions for Flutter web apps
data.what_it_does: Provides a web-specific implementation of the Cloud Functions API, enabling Flutter web applications to call Firebase Cloud Functions. It relies on the Firebase web SDK and exposes the same interface as the platform-agnostic package.
use_when: You need to call Cloud Functions from a Flutter web project
You already use firebase_core_web and want a single package for all Firebase services
avoid_when: You are building a non-Firebase backend or targeting mobile only
You need advanced client-side features not supported by the web SDK
strengths: Fully integrated with Firebase web SDK
Consistent API with other Firebase packages
weaknesses: Only works on web, not on mobile or desktop
Limited to features exposed by the Firebase web SDK
data.setup_notes: Add cloud_functions_web to pubspec, import package, ensure firebase_core_web is initialized
